data.name: Lurlene
data.long_meaning: Lurlene is a name of Old English origin meaning 'Light from the sea'. It may have been derived from the Old English 'hlyro' meaning 'bright' and 'runa' meaning 'secret' or 'mystery'. This name carries a sense of mystery and enchantment, evoking images of the shimmering sea and the hidden treasures it may hold.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and illumination.
data.numerology_meaning: Lurlene is a creative, artistic name that suggests a love of beauty, adventure, and freedom. Those with this name are often intuitive, perceptive, and have a strong connection to the natural world.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Lurlene also holds spiritual significance, as it denotes the idea of light emerging from the depths of the sea. This can be interpreted as a symbol of the divine presence in our lives, emerging from the inner depths of our being. The name Lurlene encourages us to explore the hidden treasures within ourselves, tapping into our inner wisdom, intuitiveness, and divine inspiration. Thus, Lurlene is a name that speaks to the deep spiritual longing within us all, encouraging us to tap into the divine light within and shine it out into the world.
